question.text: The angles of a triangle are in the ratio 2: 3: 7 and the radius of the circumscribed ircle is $10 \mathrm{cm}$. The length of the smallest ide is

solution.text:
Given, that angles of a triangles are $2 x, 3 x$ and
$7 x$
Since, $2 x+3 x+7 x=180$
$\Rightarrow 12 x=180^{\circ} \Rightarrow x=15^{\circ}$
So, angles are $30^{\circ}, 45^{\circ}$ and $105^{\circ}$
Now, $\frac{a}{\sin 30^{\circ}}=2 R$
$\Rightarrow \quad \frac{a}{\frac{1}{2}}=2 \times 10 \quad[\because R=10 \mathrm{cm}]$
$\Rightarrow \quad 2 a=20 \Rightarrow a=10 \mathrm{cm}$
